label: Empty-property exclusion in the Gödel no-dead-end argument
summary: The registered Gödel inference uses exclusion of the empty property, Ax2a and Ax4 on the same model. At a dead end, necessary inclusion is vacuous. Positivity of the negated empty property then entails positivity of the empty property, contradicting its exclusion. The downstream successor argument uses the resulting frame condition with excluded middle. Positivity has its Gödel meaning throughout.
